main_text.p: Nam veris instar vultus vbi tuus Plebi nitescet pacificus tua, Nubes serenata recedent, Præcipites fugient procellæ,
Te Gallus hostes auspice Barbaros Iusto lacessat Marte potentior: Tuisque nunc damnis fruentes Vexet eques metuendus hasta,
Impune captis vrbibus impotens Bellum Sabaudus monuerit impium Multisque quæsitas periclis Vsque tuas retinebit arces?
Impune Gallis seditionibus Centaurus audax riserit Allobrox, Versámque Francorum superbis Contuderit pedibus coronam?
Impune tectis[?] proditionibus Fidens, & auro, coeperit otium Turbare Bernatum, & vetustis Fœderibus violare Gentes
Gallis amicas? Tunde superbiam Tantósque fastus principis exteri. Quis arma Francorum, tuisque Auspiciis sociata, rumpet?
Sic dura cunctis sospes ab hostibus Sana ruentis vulnera patriæ: Compone ciuiles tumultus: Otia redde tuis cupita.

page.notes: Uncertain: "tectis" in line 17 (the letters read as "teƐtis"); "Vexet eques metuendus hasta," has a doubled mark at the line end, possibly a comma and a stop. Ghost text in the right margin is show-through from the reverse and is left out. The catchword "Te rege" is printed at lower right; the page has no signature.
